ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Closing_Reason__c))), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed - Won"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Closing_Reason__c, "Won"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed - Lost"), ISPICKVAL(Closing_Reason__c, "Won")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Closing Reason must be "Won" when Status is "Closed - Won", and cannot be "Won" when Status is "Closed - Lost".
